sourceEvidence.statement: Frozen Ubuntu workflow selects pnpm major 9 and requests a frozen install, but hosted probe 30106405179 proves that pnpm 9.0.0 is incompatible with the frozen lockfileVersion 6 bytes.
Target Hacker News manifest requires Node 18 or newer and is installed through the root workspace.
Root manifest defines workspace-wide pnpm scripts but does not pin a pnpm patch.
Frozen root workspace lockfileVersion 6 is bound exactly and requires the reviewed pnpm 8.6.12 compatibility profile after pnpm 9 failed closed.
